d:
Zero gear, punishing heat, and miles of treacherous terrain standing between survival and disaster. Dive into the most intense moments of Man vs. Wild as Bear Grylls puts proven survival skills to the test across deadly canyons, blistering deserts, and wild waterways. Relive the fiercest survival challenges, desperate searches for water sources, and raw determination from the ultimate wilderness survivor.
Watch Man vs. Wild Season 1 episodes 3,8,13,6,9,4,11 on Discovery Channel India.
